name: Max Echo Technology Corp.
summary: Max Echo Technology Corp., a Taiwan-based enterprise, specializes in the production and distribution of electronic components, primarily focusing on miniature inductors. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses various inductor types, including high-frequency ceramic chip, wire-wound ceramic chip, multilayer ferrite power chip, and standard multilayer ferrite chip inductors. The company also provides an array of ferrite chip beads, such as multilayer and high-frequency variants. Additional offerings include wire-wound common mode filters, adaptable sintered ferrite sheets, and coils designed for wireless charging applications. These sophisticated components are integral to a wide range of industries, finding application in telecommunications, automotive systems, industrial equipment, energy management solutions, consumer electronics, and medical devices. Established in 1992, Max Echo Technology Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.
